note: Each option is evidence: 'answering this suggests your taste on axis X sits near value V'. `weight` is how strongly. The adaptive quiz picks whichever question is expected to most reduce uncertainty about your persona, so adding a redundant question costs nothing but adding a badly-calibrated one costs accuracy.

questions.text: Movie night. Lights down. What is the perfect opening shot?

options.label: A slow pan up something enormous, with the score swelling
Something moving in the treeline that nobody on screen has noticed yet
A grainy title card over stock footage of a volcano
A small dinosaur hatching, alone, and looking for its mother

questions.text: Someone pauses the film to say the raptors are the wrong size. You:

options.label: Already had the paper open
Nod, but you are watching for the movie, not the taxonomy
Throw popcorn. It has a big mouth and that is enough
Visible latex, visible seams, visible love
A twelve-ton animatronic that actually got rained on
Photoreal skin you could count the scales on

questions.text: How big is the animal, ideally?

options.label: Exactly as big as it really was. That is already terrifying
Big enough to total a jeep
Big enough to wear a building as a hat

questions.text: The film is ninety minutes in. What is it doing?

options.label: One long, sweaty chase and you have forgotten to blink
A quiet scene where two characters finally talk
Two enormous animals demolishing a harbor
Drifting over a migrating herd while a narrator explains the mating call

questions.text: There is a kid in the cast.

options.label: Good. They are the emotional core
Fine, as long as they are in real danger
No. This film should be rated for adults and it should earn it

questions.text: You find out the whole thing was shot for $400,000.

options.label: Immediately more interesting
Depends entirely on whether the puppet works
I want the money on the screen
Most of them do not make it, and the film does not apologize
The survivors watch the animals from a distance and say nothing
The family, human or otherwise, is back together
A tail knocks over a radio tower and it cuts to black

questions.text: Club is picking from the archive. Which shelf?

options.label: Anything from before 1970
The eighties and nineties, the animatronic golden age
Whatever came out most recently

questions.text: Be honest. Why do you like dinosaur movies?

options.label: Because these animals actually existed and that is insane
Because something very large wants to eat someone
Because they are extremely stupid and I am having a great time
Because I was a kid once and it never really wore off
